Making a quick buck often entails taking financial risks and engaging in activities that may not always be ethical or legal. 5. Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs): Buying REITs is an excellent method of earning rental income. They are traded on stock exchanges and invest in real estate assets that produce regular rental revenue.

6. Trading Commodities: Engaging in commodity trading is another method of generating income quickly. Commodities such as oil, gold, and agricultural products are included in this category.

All these approaches should comply with applicable laws and regulations while maintaining high moral and ethical standards. Remember that unethical and unlawful actions may expose investors to considerable risks while yielding low returns and tarnishing reputations.
